definition.title: Design knowledge behavior evaluation
definition.purpose: Offline verification of the current five-stage Knowledge-to-capability correction plan using saved 101 inputs and real deterministic owners. Preserve advisory portable content, current contracts and failure recovery. No model execution, remote delivery or monitoring. Engineering correctness is not evidence of Knowledge efficacy.

nodes.title: Discovery
nodes.objective: Inputs: selected capability/route, known request/revision/coverage and missing fields. Outputs: exact canonical route/schema or explicit recovery; classify first acquisition vs repetition. Bypass: complete current contract. Preserve full composition contracts and genuine lost-delivery recovery. Allowed: App guidance, canonical registry and direct tests; forbidden: duplicate schema, mandatory lookup, forced refresh rejection or domain-level API names. Failure owner: current discovery owner. No new cache/runtime rewrite authorized.

nodes.title: Content
nodes.objective: Inputs: saved spatial/material adoption failures, current portable advice and user intent. Outputs: portable methods distinguishing target/setting, spatial relationships, material adequacy and detail completion. Conditions: relevant open decisions; bypass known-value/stylized/unrelated work. Allowed: shared domain content; forbidden: App tools, case answers, automatic visual approval and mandatory pre-draw gates. Failure owner: content; no cache.

nodes.title: Adoption
nodes.objective: Inputs: delivered advice, actual method/criteria, canonical routes, reference-use receipts and real artifact identities. Outputs: appropriate combined evidence scope, current reference bindings, narrow primary-agent judgments and existing-target recovery. Conditions: relevant request; preserve reference-free work and unrelated valid passes. Allowed: App architectural guidance and direct consumer tests; forbidden: second planner/store, guessed IDs, silent reference broadening, extra AI or write replay. Failure owner: current reference/preparation/review/invocation owner. No new cache; guidance must not become a Knowledge-dependent admission requirement. Delivered provider instructions must preserve the same scoped contract-acquisition guidance, without a second blanket full-schema policy.

nodes.title: Verify
nodes.objective: Inputs: current five-stage source, saved 101 input/output, real public producers/consumers and explicit controlled primary-agent judgments. Outputs: deterministic geometry/receipt/reconciliation/settlement/save/reload evidence, content identities and limitations. Conditions: exact dependency currency and actual durable acknowledgments. Allowed: current owner tests, real browser integration and existing Inspector proof. Forbidden: model execution, restored old authority, compatibility paths, synthetic aesthetic passes, push or monitoring. Failure owner: first incorrect canonical owner; preserve edits and support evidence/save-only retry without write replay.
